job.notes: Youn Myeungro is created from the National Academy of Arts page (윤명로, Youn Myeungro) and joined through After Drawing. Kim Hyung Dae is identified on the Academy page (김형대, Kim Hyung Dae) and is not given an entity, because no accepted exhibition connects him. Kim, Guirin stays unresolved. Title-only names on the 1992 Ingong and 1994 Gallery 63 records are detached. The 2014 Kukje end date is not changed.

records.title: Dansaekhwa
records.evidenceShort: Dansaekhwa, collateral event of the 56th Venice Biennale, May 8–August 15, 2015, Palazzo Contarini-Polignac. Artists: Chung Chang-Sup, Chung Sang-Hwa, Ha Chong-Hyun, Kim Whanki, Kwon Young-Woo, Lee Ufan, and Park Seo-Bo.
